section.title: General
section.rule: Framework: pytest + pytest-asyncio. Prefer httpx ASGITransport for API tests.
Default CI: unit/contract tests must not require network to LLM/embeddings/Qdrant/Docling/Postgres.

Markers: unit (default), contract, behavior, integration, e2e, demo. Live suites use @pytest.mark.integration and/or @pytest.mark.e2e and skip unless the required services answer ping via normal Settings config (no RUN_LIVE_* env flags).
Prefer deterministic mocked HTTP / MagicMock ports for unit tests; no wall-clock flakiness.
Working directory for pytest: server/ (or configure pytest rootdir to server/).

section.title: Unit tests
section.rule: Unit-test dialogue LangGraph nodes, grounding, learning, escalation with injected mock ports — no FastAPI required.
VectorStore mocks return controllable hit lists to exercise RRF/rerank/prefer-latest branches.
LLM mocks can return scripted clarify vs answer drafts; grounding must still enforce citations from retrieval mocks.
Assert graph routing: assess→retrieve always; underspecified without role+topic → clarify; specific / role+topic → ground; empty/unsupported → escalate. Clarifications are LLM-generated.

section.title: REST contract tests
section.rule: Contract tests for every endpoint in project_context REST table: status codes, schema, error shape.
OpenAPI schema generation must succeed in CI; breaking field renames require version bump discussion.
Persistence durability tests use Postgres when DATABASE_URL answers ping. No shared mutable DB state across tests.
Restart durability: with Postgres, create appeal/messages, dispose engine, reconnect, assert history and stats still present (integration when Postgres reachable).

section.title: Groundedness and escalation behavior
section.rule: When retrieval returns empty/insufficient hits: response is escalate or clarify — never a fabricated regulation quote.
When hits support the answer: response includes citations with chunk/document ids present in the corpus.
Underspecified user question: assistant asks clarifying question; appeal status clarifying; no premature escalate unless max clarify turns exceeded.
Officer-reply: creates officer message, triggers learning/ingest, subsequent query can answer from updated KB.
Assert audit/log events (or persistence audit rows) for escalate and learn paths.

section.title: Live test readiness (no env flags)
section.rule: Do not use RUN_LIVE_* skip-by-env. Live tests either run when services are reachable via Settings, or are plain unit tests with mocks.
Per-service smoke: skip unless llm / embeddings / qdrant / docling / postgres ping succeeds.
Full product path (e2e): requires LLM + embeddings + Qdrant + Postgres at minimum; Docling required only for ingest scenarios.
Unreachable services → pytest.skip with a clear reason. Never fail CI because live infra is absent.
Before live runs: copy .env.example → .env, set real base URLs/keys.

section.title: Live per-resource smoke tests
section.rule: LLM: one chat completion round-trip; assert non-empty content and latency under LLM_TIMEOUT_S.
Embeddings: embed a short Russian string; assert dense dim == EMBEDDINGS_DENSE_DIM; sparse vector present if API returns it.
Qdrant: ensure named dense+sparse collection; upsert one fixture point; hybrid search returns it.
Docling: convert a tiny fixture docx (or PDF); assert chunks non-empty; honor DOCLING_TIMEOUT_S.
LibreOffice: optional; skip if soffice binary missing.
Postgres: connect via DATABASE_URL; insert/select appeal+message; assert row survives new session (restart durability).

section.title: Live integration / e2e product scenarios
section.rule: Groundedness: ask a question answerable from ingested live corpus; assert message_kind=answer and citations reference real chunk/document ids from Qdrant/persistence. Do not assert exact LLM wording.

Clarifying dialogue: send underspecified question; assert clarification message and clarifying status; then supply details via POST /appeals/{id}/messages with flat body {"content":"..."}; assert eventual answer or escalate per policy.
Escalation: ask out-of-KB question; assert escalation entity, user notice, no invented citations.
Officer-reply learning: after escalate, POST officer-reply; assert KB update (ingest) and that a follow-up similar question can be answered with citations (may require short wait/index refresh).
Prefer isolated Qdrant collection or alias suffix (_test) for e2e; never wipe production alias in shared envs.
Example commands (from server/): pytest pytest -m integration pytest -m e2e rag-server check

section.title: Forbidden in default CI
section.rule: No real HTTP to LLM_BASE_URL / EMBEDDINGS_BASE_URL / QDRANT_URL / DOCLING_BASE_URL in default unit tests. Integration/e2e may call them only when those services answer ping.
No dependency on soffice binary in default unit tests.
Do not assert on live model wording; assert on structure, citations, status, and policy outcomes.
Product runtime must use real provider adapters only; unit tests mock ports or HTTP.

section.title: Demo scenarios
section.rule: Provide pytest markers or scripts for the three prototype success criteria (grounded, clarify, learn) against live infra.
Same scenarios should be invokable with pytest -m e2e when infra is available; document path in README / DEMO.md.
